statement: On unchanged virtualgamepad b23cb41 Bluetooth-bus UHID and Linux6.12.113+deb13-arm64, holding the exact-owned MotionPlus evdev node open without SDL initialization produced acknowledged A600FE mode04/05 mapping and changing ABS_RX/RY/RZ with exact expected centered all-slow extrema for both distinct drive vectors. Mode04 emitted1108 valid gyro packets; mode05 emitted528 gyro and528 alternating Nunchuk packets, no field/flag/alternation mismatches. This is measured kernel-consumer evidence for the virtual device, not physical fidelity, calibrated rates, radio or SDL acceptance.

applicability.revision: virtualgamepad b23cb41 / consumer SDL3.2.10 and Linux6.12.113; physical revision unmeasured
